strings.notes: 瑞穗 not in 0719; US contact Picnicker Gina (US 0695)

strings.zh: 一看到强劲的训练师,{NEWLINE}我就会不由自主地去为他加油。{SCROLL}我在这一带散步的时候,{NEWLINE}有时候会捡到道具。{CLEAR}下次我再捡到的话{CLEAR}就送给你好了！{SCROLL}要是你乐意的话,{NEWLINE}把电话号码告诉给我吧。{CLEAR}这样我捡到了就能马上联系你。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Whenever I see a strong Trainer,{NEWLINE}I want to be their cheerleader.{SCROLL}When I’m out on a walk,{NEWLINE}I sometimes pick up items.{SCROLL}If I find anything, you can have it!{SCROLL}Want to give me your number?{NEWLINE}I’ll call whenever I get anything.{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 一旦我有什么收获{NEWLINE}我就会给你打电话的！
strings.en: I’ll call as soon as I get anything!

strings.zh: 你居然⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不过我还是会为你加油的。
strings.en: Really? Well, I’ll still be cheering{NEWLINE}for you!

strings.zh: 我捡到道具就会送给你的！{SCROLL}能把你的电话号码{NEWLINE}留给我吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If I find an item, you can have it!{NEWLINE}Want to give me your number?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你终于来了！{SCROLL}我想你会很乐意地{NEWLINE}收下吧⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: You’re here at last!{NEWLINE}I think this will make you happy.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你这么喜欢打电话啊,{NEWLINE}我们都离得这么近了！
strings.en: You must really like phone calls to be{NEWLINE}right nearby and using the phone!

strings.zh: 我和{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}最近觉得{CLEAR}越来越合得来了！{SCROLL}对了,还有！{NEWLINE}之前我们和{VAR:0100:11}战斗,{CLEAR}终于把它给打败了！{CLEAR}我的状态越来越好了！{SCROLL}下次再聊吧
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} and I are getting more{NEWLINE}in sync with each other.{SCROLL}We battled a wild {VAR:0100:11} and{NEWLINE}managed to beat it in a close match.{CLEAR}We’re getting into the groove!{SCROLL}Bye! Let’s chat again!

strings.zh: 我和{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}最近觉得{CLEAR}越来越合得来了！{SCROLL}不过,{SCROLL}我还是没抓到{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11},{CLEAR}都有点不耐烦了。{SCROLL}我们下次再聊吧。
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} and I are getting more in{NEWLINE}sync with each other.{SCROLL}But, you know what?{SCROLL}I still haven’t caught {VAR:0100:11}. I’m{NEWLINE}getting a little impatient...{SCROLL}Bye! Let’s chat again!
strings.notes: US 0695/8 | RV073: meaning: 有点不耐烦 is a little impatient, not beyond frustrating

strings.zh: 喂喂,能再来做一次{NEWLINE}我的练习对手吗？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}这次我绝不会留情了！
strings.en: Hey, would you be my{NEWLINE}practice partner again?{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}. This{NEWLINE}time I won’t go easy on you!

strings.zh: 快来和我对战啊！{NEWLINE}我就在{VAR:0104:3}！
strings.en: Hurry up and come battle me!{NEWLINE}I’m right at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 快来和我对战啊！{NEWLINE}我就在{VAR:0104:3}！
strings.en: Hurry up and come battle me!{NEWLINE}I’m right at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 抱歉,最近{NEWLINE}没捡到什么好的道具⋯⋯{SCROLL}有了的话我肯定会给你的！
strings.en: Sorry, I haven’t found anything useful{NEWLINE}yet... I promise, if I find anything, you{CLEAR}can have it!

strings.zh: 今天捡到好东西了,{NEWLINE}我想把它送给你{CLEAR}所以就打电话了！{SCROLL}你能来拿吗？{NEWLINE}我就在{VAR:0104:3}。
strings.en: I picked up something nice today.{NEWLINE}I want you to have it, so I called!{SCROLL}You will come for it, won’t you?{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} is where I am.

strings.zh: 喂,你怎么还不来啊,{NEWLINE}我都急死了⋯⋯{SCROLL}快来{VAR:0104:3}！
strings.en: I’m getting really impatient, waiting to{NEWLINE}give you my present!{SCROLL}Hurry over to {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你有听过吗？{SCROLL}满金市的广播塔{NEWLINE}被火箭队劫持了！{SCROLL}大家都没事吧？
strings.en: Have you heard about Team Rocket?{SCROLL}They’ve taken over the{NEWLINE}Radio Tower in Goldenrod.{SCROLL}Are the people inside safe?
